common.back.description: Settings: the back button in the page bar of every sub-page, also its tooltip. voice/ui/settings.js (render).

common.cancel.description: Settings: button that closes a dialog without a change. voice/ui/settings.js (dialog, choose).

common.close.description: Settings: button that closes an information dialog, such as Licenses or Error details. voice/ui/settings.js (dialog).

common.save.description: Settings: the filled button of a provider form, which checks and saves provider, key, endpoint and model together. voice/ui/settings.js (providerForm).

common.remove.description: Settings: button beside "Key saved" that deletes the saved API key at once. voice/ui/settings.js (providerForm).

common.replace.description: Settings: button beside "Key saved" that shows an empty field for a new API key. voice/ui/settings.js (providerForm).

common.browse.description: Settings: button that opens the system's folder picker, for the model folder and the recordings folder. voice/ui/settings.js (modelCard, storagePage).

common.openFolder.description: Settings: button that shows a folder in Explorer, such as the folder of Rukoo's discovery file. voice/ui/settings.js (rukooPage, storagePage).

common.refresh.description: Settings: button beside the Model field that asks the provider which models it has. voice/ui/settings.js (providerForm).

common.loading.description: Settings: the Refresh button's label while the model list loads. voice/ui/settings.js (providerForm).

common.on.description: Settings: value of a row whose feature is switched on, such as Filler words. voice/ui/settings.js (mainPage).

common.off.description: Settings: value of a row whose feature is off, and the "no key" choice in key lists (Rewrite key, Stop key). voice/ui/settings.js (mainPage, keyChoice).

common.system.description: Settings > General: the Language or Theme choice that follows Windows. voice/ui/settings.js (mainPage).

common.errorDetails.description: Settings: link button after a failure, and the title of the dialog that shows the full error text from the app, which stays in English. voice/ui/settings.js (errorDetails).

pill.arming.description: Pill: dictation key pressed, the microphone is opening. Short; the pill holds about 220px of text. voice/ui/pill.js (viewOf).

pill.listening.description: Pill: the microphone records while the user holds the dictation key. voice/ui/pill.js (viewOf).

pill.listeningEdit.description: Pill: the microphone records while the user holds the rewrite key over selected text and says what should change. voice/ui/pill.js (viewOf).

pill.noAudio.description: Pill: the user holds the key, but the microphone heard nothing for 5 seconds. Cleared at the first sound. voice/ui/pill.js (viewOf).

pill.loadingModel.description: Pill: key released, and the local Orukeet model loads into memory before it can transcribe. voice/ui/pill.js (viewOf).

pill.transcribing.description: Pill: key released, the speech is being turned into text. Shown with a moving shimmer. voice/ui/pill.js (viewOf).

pill.rewriting.description: Pill: the rewrite provider polishes the dictation or edits the selected text. voice/ui/pill.js (viewOf).

pill.inserted.description: Pill: the dictated text was typed into the app with focus. {count}: number of words. voice/ui/pill.js (viewOf).

pill.rewrote.description: Pill: the selected text was replaced with the rewritten text. voice/ui/pill.js (viewOf).

pill.nothingHeard.description: Pill: the user released the key, but the recording held no speech, so nothing was typed. voice/ui/pill.js (viewOf).

pill.selectTextBox.description: Pill: no text field had focus when the user pressed the dictation key. Recording continues. voice/ui/pill.js (viewOf).

pill.error.selectText.description: Pill error: the rewrite key was pressed without selected text. voice/ui/pill.js (viewOf).

pill.error.selectionTooLong.description: Pill error: the selected text is too long to rewrite. voice/ui/pill.js (viewOf).

pill.error.offline.description: Pill error: the provider couldn't be reached over the network. The full error goes to a tray notification. voice/ui/pill.js (viewOf).

pill.error.noKey.description: Pill error: the chosen cloud provider has no API key in Settings. voice/ui/pill.js (viewOf).

pill.error.auth.description: Pill error: the provider rejected the API key (HTTP 401 or 403). voice/ui/pill.js (viewOf).

pill.error.timeout.description: Pill error: the provider took too long to answer. voice/ui/pill.js (viewOf).

pill.error.mic.description: Pill error: Voice couldn't open the microphone. voice/ui/pill.js (viewOf).

pill.error.model.description: Pill error: the local Orukeet model couldn't load. voice/ui/pill.js (viewOf).

pill.error.modelMissing.description: Pill error: Orukeet is chosen but its files aren't downloaded. voice/ui/pill.js (viewOf).

pill.error.blocked.description: Pill error: Windows blocked typing into an app that runs as administrator. voice/ui/pill.js (viewOf).

pill.error.generic.description: Pill error: any other failure. The full error goes to a tray notification. voice/ui/pill.js (viewOf).

pill.meeting.recording.description: Pill: a meeting is recording; the elapsed time follows. voice/ui/pill.js (viewOf).

pill.meeting.paused.description: Pill: the meeting is paused; the elapsed time follows and keeps running. voice/ui/pill.js (viewOf).

pill.meeting.confirmStop.description: Pill: the stop button after the first click; a second click within 3 seconds stops the meeting. Very short: it sits inside a 28px button. voice/ui/pill.js (viewOf).

pill.meeting.saving.description: Pill: the meeting stopped and Voice closes the recording. Transcription continues in the background. voice/ui/pill.js (viewOf).

pill.meetingFailed.description: Pill error: the meeting couldn't be finished. voice/ui/pill.js (viewOf).

pill.micLost.description: Pill: the microphone disappeared during a meeting, for example an unplugged headset. The call audio keeps recording. voice/ui/pill.js (viewOf).

pill.micBack.description: Pill: the microphone works again after "Microphone lost". voice/ui/pill.js (viewOf).

pill.videoDropped.disk.description: Pill: Voice stopped recording the screen to keep the audio, because the disk is full. Not used in Voice 0.1. voice/ui/pill.js (viewOf).

pill.videoDropped.encoder.description: Pill: Voice stopped recording the screen because the video encoder failed. Not used in Voice 0.1. voice/ui/pill.js (viewOf).

pill.stopButton.description: Pill: accessible name of the stop button. The app also uses it as the title of the native window over the button. voice/ui/pill.js (renderButton).

pill.dev.description: Pill: small tag after the label in a development copy, so testers can tell it from the installed app. voice/ui/pill.js (render).

app.tray.tooltip.description: Tray icon tooltip while no meeting records. Product name. Read by voice-app (see voice/ui/API.md, "Strings the app reads").

app.tray.tooltipRecording.message: Rukoo Voice is recording a meeting
app.tray.tooltipRecording.description: Tray icon tooltip while a meeting records or is paused. Read by voice-app (see voice/ui/API.md).

app.tray.settings.description: Tray menu item that opens the Settings window. Read by voice-app (see voice/ui/API.md).

app.tray.startMeeting.description: Tray menu item that starts recording a meeting. Read by voice-app (see voice/ui/API.md).

app.tray.pauseMeeting.description: Tray menu item while a meeting records. Read by voice-app (see voice/ui/API.md).

app.tray.resumeMeeting.description: Tray menu item while a meeting is paused. Read by voice-app (see voice/ui/API.md).

app.tray.stopMeeting.description: Tray menu item while a meeting records or is paused. Read by voice-app (see voice/ui/API.md).

app.tray.quit.description: Tray menu item that quits the app. A recording meeting keeps recording in its own process. Read by voice-app (see voice/ui/API.md).

app.notify.dictationFailed.description: Title of a tray notification after a dictation failed; the body is the full error, often an English message from the provider. Read by voice-app (see voice/ui/API.md).

app.notify.rewriteFailed.description: Title of a tray notification after rewriting the dictation or the selected text failed; the body says why. Read by voice-app (see voice/ui/API.md).

app.notify.noTextBox.description: Title of a tray notification when no text field had focus as the dictated text went out; Voice inserts it anyway. Read by voice-app (see voice/ui/API.md).

app.notify.meeting.description: Title of a tray notification about a meeting: it was cut off and saved, couldn't be stopped, or its transcript failed. Read by voice-app (see voice/ui/API.md).

app.notify.settings.description: Title of a tray notification about Settings, such as a damaged settings file Voice replaced with defaults, or an Ownkey import that failed. Read by voice-app (see voice/ui/API.md).

app.notify.welcome.description: Title of the tray notification on the first start when dictation can't work yet; the body points to Settings > Transcription. Read by voice-app (see voice/ui/API.md).

settings.title.description: Settings: the window title. The app sets it on the native window too. voice/ui/settings.html; voice/ui/settings.js (applyLanguage).

settings.main.title.description: Settings: heading of the top page. Product name. voice/ui/settings.js (mainPage).

settings.groups.dictation.description: Settings: group title above the dictation rows on the top page. voice/ui/settings.js (mainPage).

settings.groups.meetings.description: Settings: group title above the meeting rows on the top page, and an area in the Ownkey import report. voice/ui/settings.js (mainPage, importPage).

settings.groups.general.description: Settings: group title above Language and Theme. voice/ui/settings.js (mainPage).

settings.groups.about.description: Settings: group title above updates, the Ownkey import, logs, licenses and version. voice/ui/settings.js (mainPage).

settings.status.dictation.description: Settings > Status: title of the row that says whether dictation works. voice/ui/settings.js (mainPage).

settings.status.dictationHelp.message: Hold {key} to dictate. Hold {rewriteKey} to change selected text.
settings.status.dictationHelp.description: Settings > Status: description of the Dictation row. {key}, {rewriteKey}: key names such as "Right Alt", shown as keyboard keys. voice/ui/settings.js (mainPage).

settings.status.dictationHelpNoRewrite.description: Settings > Status: description of the Dictation row when the rewrite key is off. {key}: a key name shown as a keyboard key. voice/ui/settings.js (mainPage).

settings.status.ready.description: Settings > Status: green status of the Dictation row. voice/ui/settings.js (dictationStatus).

settings.status.loadingModel.description: Settings > Status: orange status while Orukeet loads into memory. voice/ui/settings.js (dictationStatus).

settings.status.modelMissing.description: Settings > Status: red status when Orukeet is chosen but not downloaded; the row opens Transcription. voice/ui/settings.js (dictationStatus).

settings.status.noKey.description: Settings > Status: red status when the cloud provider has no API key; the row opens Transcription. voice/ui/settings.js (dictationStatus).

settings.status.noMic.description: Settings > Status: red status when Windows reports no microphone. voice/ui/settings.js (dictationStatus).

settings.status.rukoo.description: Settings > Status: title of the row with the connection to Rukoo Mail; it opens the Rukoo page. Product name. voice/ui/settings.js (mainPage).

settings.status.ownkey.description: Settings > Status: warning row when Ownkey for Windows runs and listens on one of Voice's keys. voice/ui/settings.js (mainPage).

settings.status.ownkeyHelp.message: Ownkey also answers {keys}. Quit Ownkey or choose other keys.
settings.status.ownkeyHelp.description: Settings > Status: description of the Ownkey warning. {keys}: one or more key names joined as a list, such as "Right Alt and Right Ctrl". voice/ui/settings.js (mainPage).

settings.rukoo.connected.description: Settings: green status of the Rukoo row; Rukoo is connected to Voice. voice/ui/settings.js (rukooStatus).

settings.rukoo.notRunning.description: Settings: grey status of the Rukoo row; no Rukoo is connected. voice/ui/settings.js (rukooStatus).

settings.rukoo.rukooOutdated.description: Settings: orange status when Rukoo speaks an older bridge protocol than Voice accepts. voice/ui/settings.js (rukooStatus).

settings.rukoo.voiceOutdated.description: Settings: orange status when Rukoo speaks a newer bridge protocol than this Voice. voice/ui/settings.js (rukooStatus).

settings.rukoo.refused.description: Settings: red status when a client connected with the wrong token. voice/ui/settings.js (rukooStatus).

settings.dictation.key.description: Settings > Dictation: row and choice dialog title for the key the user holds to dictate. voice/ui/settings.js (mainPage).

settings.dictation.keyHelp.message: Hold to record, release to type.
settings.dictation.keyHelp.description: Settings > Dictation: description of Dictation key. voice/ui/settings.js (mainPage).

settings.dictation.paste.description: Settings > Dictation: switch for inserting text through the clipboard instead of typing it key by key. voice/ui/settings.js (mainPage).

settings.dictation.pasteHelp.message: Inserts text through the clipboard and puts your clipboard back afterwards. Faster, and more reliable in most apps.
settings.dictation.pasteHelp.description: Settings > Dictation: description of Paste mode. voice/ui/settings.js (mainPage).

settings.dictation.chime.description: Settings > Dictation: switch for a short sound when the microphone is ready. voice/ui/settings.js (mainPage).

settings.dictation.chimeHelp.message: A short ping when the microphone is ready.
settings.dictation.chimeHelp.description: Settings > Dictation: description of Ready chime. voice/ui/settings.js (mainPage).

settings.dictation.login.description: Settings > Dictation: switch that starts Voice when the user signs in to Windows. voice/ui/settings.js (mainPage).

settings.dictation.loginHelp.message: Voice waits in the tray when you sign in.
settings.dictation.loginHelp.description: Settings > Dictation: description of Start at login. voice/ui/settings.js (mainPage).

settings.dictation.loginDev.message: A development copy never starts at login.
settings.dictation.loginDev.description: Settings > Dictation: description of Start at login in a development copy, where the switch is disabled. voice/ui/settings.js (mainPage).

settings.dictation.transcription.description: Settings > Dictation: row that opens the Transcription page; also that page's title and an area in the Ownkey import report. voice/ui/settings.js (mainPage, transcriptionPage, importPage).

settings.dictation.dictionary.description: Settings > Dictation: row that opens the Dictionary page; also that page's title and an area in the Ownkey import report. voice/ui/settings.js (mainPage, dictionaryPage, importPage).

settings.dictation.fillers.description: Settings > Dictation: row that opens the Filler words page; also that page's title and an area in the Ownkey import report. voice/ui/settings.js (mainPage, fillersPage, importPage).

settings.dictation.rewriting.description: Settings > Dictation: row that opens the Rewriting page; also that page's title and an area in the Ownkey import report. voice/ui/settings.js (mainPage, rewritingPage, importPage).

settings.rewriting.valuePolish.description: Settings > Dictation: value of the Rewriting row when auto-rewrite is on and the rewrite key is off. voice/ui/settings.js (rewritingValue).

settings.rewriting.valueEdits.description: Settings > Dictation: value of the Rewriting row when only the rewrite key is on. voice/ui/settings.js (rewritingValue).

settings.rewriting.valueBoth.description: Settings > Dictation: value of the Rewriting row when auto-rewrite and the rewrite key are both on. voice/ui/settings.js (rewritingValue).

settings.pill.edge.description: Settings > Dictation: row and choice dialog title for where the pill (the small status bar during dictation) appears. voice/ui/settings.js (mainPage).

settings.pill.bottom.description: Settings > Dictation > Pill position: choice. voice/ui/settings.js (mainPage).

settings.pill.top.description: Settings > Dictation > Pill position: choice. voice/ui/settings.js (mainPage).

settings.pill.hide.message: Hide the pill from screen sharing
settings.pill.hide.description: Settings > Dictation: switch that keeps the pill out of screen shares and recordings. voice/ui/settings.js (mainPage).

settings.pill.hideHelp.message: Keeps the pill out of screen shares and screen recordings.
settings.pill.hideHelp.description: Settings > Dictation: description of Hide the pill from screen sharing. voice/ui/settings.js (mainPage).

settings.provider.custom.description: Settings: provider choice for a server that speaks OpenAI's API, such as LM Studio. voice/ui/settings.js (providerLabel).

settings.provider.orukeet.description: Settings > Transcription: provider choice for the local Orukeet model, and the Transcription row's value. voice/ui/settings.js (providerLabel).

settings.provider.orukeetMeetings.description: Settings > Meeting transcription: the default provider choice, which keeps meeting audio on the computer. voice/ui/settings.js (providerLabel).

settings.provider.provider.description: Settings: label of the provider list in a provider form. voice/ui/settings.js (providerForm).

settings.provider.apiKey.description: Settings: label of the API key field in a provider form. voice/ui/settings.js (providerForm).

settings.provider.keySaved.description: Settings: shown instead of the API key field when a key is saved. The key itself never reaches the window. voice/ui/settings.js (providerForm).

settings.provider.keyPlaceholder.description: Settings: placeholder of the empty API key field. voice/ui/settings.js (providerForm).

settings.provider.keyOptional.message: Leave it blank when the server doesn't need a key.
settings.provider.keyOptional.description: Settings: help under the API key field for Custom and Ollama, whose local servers often need no key. voice/ui/settings.js (providerForm).

settings.provider.endpoint.description: Settings: label of the endpoint URL field in a provider form. voice/ui/settings.js (providerForm).

settings.provider.model.description: Settings: label of the model field in a provider form. voice/ui/settings.js (providerForm).

settings.provider.modelPlaceholder.description: Settings: placeholder of the empty model field. voice/ui/settings.js (providerForm).

settings.provider.modelsFound.description: Settings: line under the Model field after Refresh. {count}: number of models the provider listed. voice/ui/settings.js (providerForm).

settings.provider.noModels.description: Settings: line under the Model field when Refresh found nothing. {provider}: provider name such as Mistral. voice/ui/settings.js (providerForm).

settings.provider.modelsFailed.description: Settings: line under the Model field when Refresh failed. {error}: the app's English error text. voice/ui/settings.js (providerForm).

settings.provider.needAudio.message: Choose an audio endpoint and model before saving.
settings.provider.needAudio.description: Settings > Transcription: Save refused because the endpoint or model is empty. voice/ui/settings.js (validateProvider).

settings.provider.needRewrite.message: Choose a rewrite endpoint and model before saving.
settings.provider.needRewrite.description: Settings > Rewriting: Save refused because the endpoint or model is empty. voice/ui/settings.js (validateProvider).

settings.provider.needMeeting.message: Choose an endpoint and model for meeting transcription before saving.
settings.provider.needMeeting.description: Settings > Meeting transcription: Save refused because the endpoint or model is empty. voice/ui/settings.js (validateProvider).

settings.provider.loadingOrukeet.description: Settings: status beside Save while the app loads and checks Orukeet before it saves. voice/ui/settings.js (providerForm).

settings.provider.saving.description: Settings: status beside Save while the app saves. voice/ui/settings.js (providerForm).

settings.provider.saved.description: Settings: green status beside Save after saving. voice/ui/settings.js (providerForm).

settings.provider.failed.description: Settings: red status beside Save when saving failed; Error details follows. voice/ui/settings.js (providerForm).

settings.transcription.intro.message: Where your voice becomes text: on this computer with Orukeet, or through a provider with your own key.
settings.transcription.intro.description: Settings > Transcription: paragraph at the top of the page. voice/ui/settings.js (transcriptionPage).

settings.transcription.speechToText.description: Settings > Transcription: group title above the provider form. voice/ui/settings.js (transcriptionPage).

settings.transcription.language.description: Settings > Transcription: label of the spoken-language list. voice/ui/settings.js (providerForm).

settings.transcription.languageAuto.description: Settings > Transcription > Language: the provider detects the language itself. voice/ui/settings.js (providerForm).

settings.transcription.languageHelp.message: Auto works for most people. Set a language when the audio provider keeps guessing wrong.
settings.transcription.languageHelp.description: Settings > Transcription: help under Language. voice/ui/settings.js (providerForm).

settings.transcription.languageOrukeet.message: Orukeet recognizes the language by itself.
settings.transcription.languageOrukeet.description: Settings > Transcription: help under the disabled Language list when Orukeet is chosen. voice/ui/settings.js (providerForm).

settings.orukeet.title.description: Settings > Transcription: group title of the local model card, shown when Local (Orukeet) is chosen. voice/ui/settings.js (modelCard).

settings.orukeet.about.message: Orukeet by Oruk AI, based on NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3. Audio never leaves this computer. Rewriting still sends text to your rewrite provider; for offline use, choose local Ollama or turn rewriting off.
settings.orukeet.about.description: Settings > Transcription: paragraph in the Orukeet card. voice/ui/settings.js (modelCard).

settings.orukeet.licence.message: Weights under CC BY-SA 4.0. The license and attribution stay with the download.
settings.orukeet.licence.description: Settings > Transcription: license line at the end of the Orukeet card. voice/ui/settings.js (modelCard).

settings.model.page.description: Settings: link to the model's page on Hugging Face, in a model card. voice/ui/settings.js (modelCard).

settings.model.files.description: Settings: title of the row with the model's status and folder in a model card. voice/ui/settings.js (modelCard).

settings.model.progress.description: Settings: model status during a download. {stage}: Downloading, Verifying or Extracting. {percent}: a whole number. voice/ui/settings.js (modelStatus).

settings.model.verifying.description: Settings: model download stage while Voice checks the files against their pinned checksums. voice/ui/settings.js (modelStatus).

settings.model.extracting.description: Settings: model download stage while Voice unpacks the archive. voice/ui/settings.js (modelStatus).

settings.model.loading.description: Settings: model status while the model loads into memory. voice/ui/settings.js (modelStatus).

settings.model.loadFailed.description: Settings: red status of a model that failed to load; the app's English error follows on the next line, cut at 180 characters, with all of it behind Error details. voice/ui/settings.js (modelStatus).

settings.model.failed.description: Settings: red status of a model whose download or checksum check failed; the app's English error follows on the next line. voice/ui/settings.js (modelStatus).

settings.model.active.description: Settings: model status when this model is the chosen provider. {state}: Loaded, Not loaded, Loading or Error. voice/ui/settings.js (modelStatus).

settings.model.state.loaded.description: Settings: {state} of "Active · {state}": the model is in memory. voice/ui/settings.js (modelStatus).

settings.model.state.unloaded.description: Settings: {state} of "Active · {state}": the model loads on the next dictation. voice/ui/settings.js (modelStatus).

settings.model.state.error.description: Settings: {state} of "Active · {state}"; Error details shows why. voice/ui/settings.js (modelStatus).

settings.model.installed.description: Settings: model status when the files are there but another provider is chosen. voice/ui/settings.js (modelStatus).

settings.model.unavailable.description: Settings: model status when the files are there but the runtime can't use them. voice/ui/settings.js (modelStatus).

settings.model.missing.description: Settings: model status before a download. {size}: download size such as "487 MB". voice/ui/settings.js (modelStatus).

settings.model.download.description: Settings: filled button in a model card that downloads the model. voice/ui/settings.js (modelCard).

settings.model.cancel.description: Settings: button in a model card while it downloads. voice/ui/settings.js (modelCard).

settings.model.remove.description: Settings: button in a model card that deletes a model Voice downloaded itself. voice/ui/settings.js (modelCard).

settings.model.removeTitle.description: Settings: title of the dialog that confirms Remove download. {model}: model name such as Orukeet. voice/ui/settings.js (modelCard).

settings.model.removeBody.message: Voice deletes the model files from its own folder. You can download them again later.
settings.model.removeBody.description: Settings: body of the dialog that confirms Remove download. voice/ui/settings.js (modelCard).

settings.model.inOwnkey.message: Shared with Ownkey. Remove it in Ownkey.
settings.model.inOwnkey.description: Settings: note in a model card instead of Remove download, when the model is in Ownkey's folder. Voice never deletes Ownkey's files. voice/ui/settings.js (modelCard).

settings.model.folder.description: Settings > Transcription: title of the row with the folder Voice downloads Orukeet to or reads it from. voice/ui/settings.js (modelCard).

settings.model.folderHelp.description: Settings > Transcription: description of Model folder. voice/ui/settings.js (modelCard).

settings.model.folderAuto.message: Automatic: Ownkey's models first, then Voice's own folder
settings.model.folderAuto.description: Settings > Transcription: value of Model folder when the user chose no folder. voice/ui/settings.js (modelCard).

settings.model.folderReset.description: Settings > Transcription: button that clears a chosen model folder. voice/ui/settings.js (modelCard).

settings.model.idle.description: Settings > Transcription: label of the minutes field. voice/ui/settings.js (modelCard).

settings.model.idleHelp.description: Settings > Transcription: help under Unload after idle. voice/ui/settings.js (modelCard).

settings.model.idleInvalid.message: Enter zero or a positive number of minutes, up to 1440.
settings.model.idleInvalid.description: Settings > Transcription: error under Unload after idle. voice/ui/settings.js (modelCard).

settings.dictionary.intro.message: Names and terms typed the way you spell them.
settings.dictionary.intro.description: Settings > Dictionary: paragraph at the top of the page. voice/ui/settings.js (dictionaryPage).

settings.dictionary.corrections.description: Settings > Dictionary: count of corrections, after the words count. voice/ui/settings.js (dictionaryCount).

settings.dictionary.vocabulary.description: Settings > Dictionary: group title while the dictionary is empty. voice/ui/settings.js (dictionaryPage).

settings.dictionary.correctHelp.description: Settings > Dictionary: description of Correct a misspelling. voice/ui/settings.js (dictionaryPage).

settings.dictionary.word.description: Settings > Dictionary: label of the field for a new word. voice/ui/settings.js (dictionaryPage).

settings.dictionary.wordPlaceholder.description: Settings > Dictionary: placeholder of the field for a new word. voice/ui/settings.js (dictionaryPage).

settings.dictionary.from.description: Settings > Dictionary: label of the field for what the recognizer types wrong. voice/ui/settings.js (dictionaryPage).

settings.dictionary.to.description: Settings > Dictionary: label of the field for what should be typed instead. voice/ui/settings.js (dictionaryPage).

settings.dictionary.addWord.description: Settings > Dictionary: filled button that adds the word. voice/ui/settings.js (dictionaryPage).

settings.dictionary.addCorrection.description: Settings > Dictionary: filled button that adds the correction. voice/ui/settings.js (dictionaryPage).

settings.dictionary.needWord.message: Type a word or name first.
